clusters.label: Setup hinges on in-house tech skills
clusters.rationale: Onboarding speed is decided by whether the customer has developers to connect the integration: one afternoon with them, weeks and support callbacks without.

clusters.label: Pulling data out through fragile workarounds
clusters.rationale: With no API, users get data out of Pulse via CSV exports, scripts and manual rebuilds that are costly, brittle and person-dependent.

clusters.label: Per-user pricing caps sharing
clusters.rationale: Charging every viewer or guest as a paying user pushes customers to limit access, even though shared dashboards are what their own audiences value most.

clusters.label: Defending numbers before management
clusters.rationale: Whether figures are trusted depends on whether the user can verify and justify them to leadership, from cross-checking after an incident to never seeing a discrepancy.

clusters.label: Asking for context behind metrics
clusters.rationale: Users want definitions and provenance attached to each metric so teams read the same number the same way.

clusters.label: Daily value once data flows
clusters.rationale: Once integration works, the dashboards and live map become clear, everyday tools that replace older routines.
